data.name: Customer - Look Up - No ID
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves customer data without an identifier, useful for testing how the resource handles an omitted lookup value.
Use for: test missing ID handling, retrieve default customer results, inspect validation behavior
Not supported: targeted customer lookup, customer creation, customer updates

data.name: Customer - Look Up - Blank ID
data.evaluateGuide:
Retrieves customer data with an explicitly blank identifier to evaluate empty-value handling.
Use for: test blank ID handling, inspect validation behavior, evaluate empty lookup responses
Not supported: valid customer lookup, customer creation, customer updates

data.name: Customer - Look Up - Not Found ID
data.description:
A valid ID but does not exist in the system. 
Should it return a message?
Should it be a 404 Not Found?
data.evaluateGuide:
Looks up a customer using a valid-format identifier that does not exist, allowing evaluation of not-found behavior and response status.
Use for: test missing customer handling, verify 404 behavior, inspect error messages
Not supported: existing customer retrieval, customer creation, customer updates

data.name: Lookup
data.description: This API enables you to search records with a phone or email id in different modules and fields.
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches Vtiger CRM records by phone or email across specified modules and fields.
Use for: find by phone, find by email, search selected modules
Not supported: record creation, record updates, broad unfiltered exports

data.name: Associating a lookup record through an external field
data.description: In this example, Contacts is the base module's API name where AccountName is a lookup field's API name in the Contacts module. ExternalAccount_ID is the API name of the external field in the Accounts module. We will reference the external field's value in the Accounts module to create a record in the Contacts module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Contacts record while resolving its account lookup through an external field value.
Use for: create contact with account reference, link contact to account, resolve external account ID
Not supported: contact updates, standalone account creation, subform lookup insertion

data.name: Inserting a subform lookup record through an external field in the associated module
data.description: In this example, SubformExternal is the API name of the subform in the Contacts module. It has a look up field to the Deals module. The Deals module has an external field ExternalDeal_ID. We will reference this external field in the subform and insert a record in the Contacts module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Creates a Contacts record with a subform lookup linked to a Deals record through an external field.
Use for: create contact subform data, link subform to deal, resolve external deal ID
Not supported: standalone deal creation, existing record updates, non-subform associations

data.name: Updating a record through the external value of a lookup record in that module
data.description: In this example, Contacts is the base module and contains an account lookup field Account_Name. To update a record in the Contacts module, you must specify the external field's API name and its value in the Accounts module, and the external field's API name and its value in the Contacts module.
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates a Contacts record using external field values to identify the contact and its related account lookup.
Use for: update contact by external value, link account by external value, modify contact fields
Not supported: contact creation, standalone account updates, subform updates

data.name: Search for contacts
data.evaluateGuide:
Searches HubSpot contact records using structured search criteria supplied in the payload.
Use for: find contacts, filter by contact properties, retrieve matching contact records
Not supported: contact creation, contact updates, company or deal searches

data.name: Updating a subform lookup record through an external field in the associated module
data.description: Specify the external field's API name and its value in the lookup field JSON object of the Subform.
data.evaluateGuide:
Updates a Contacts subform lookup by resolving its related record through an external field value.
Use for: update subform lookup, link subform to external record, modify contact subform data
Not supported: contact creation, standalone related-record updates, non-subform associations

data.name: Customer - Look Up - Invalid ID
data.description:
Returns a 200 OK response. 
Should this be the case? 
Would a 404 make more sense?
Should be return a better error message?
data.evaluateGuide:
Looks up a customer with an invalid identifier format to evaluate validation and error-response behavior.
Use for: test invalid ID handling, inspect validation messages, evaluate error status
Not supported: valid customer retrieval, customer creation, customer updates
